description: Create or update a horizon, stage, or phase in the project hierarchy (AD-14). For stages and horizons this UPSERTS: if the named entity exists it is updated, otherwise it is CREATED (pass a label). Phases are update-only (they evolve via plan/strategy). For stages you can set exit_criteria (a checklist), or flip a single criterion with set_criterion_met. NEVER auto-advances — progression is human-in-loop via strategy_review. Does not call the Anthropic API.

exit_criteria.description: Checklist defining when a STAGE is done. Each item is a completion condition. REPLACES existing criteria (resets met state — use set_criterion_met to flip one).

horizon.description: Parent horizon (name/slug/id) when CREATING a stage. Defaults to the sole horizon if only one exists.

label.description: Display label. Required to CREATE a new stage/horizon when `name` does not match an existing one (e.g. "S2: Alpha Cohort").

name.description: The label, slug, or ID of the entity. On create, becomes the label if `label` is omitted.

set_criterion_met.description: Flip a single stage exit criterion (task-1625). { criterion_id, met, evidence? }.

evidence.description: Optional evidence for a met criterion (e.g. "task-1234 shipped").

slug.description: Explicit slug for a new entity (stage/horizon). Auto-derived from the label when omitted.

sort_order.description: Display order for a new entity. Auto-computed (max existing + 10) when omitted.

status.description: The status to set. On create, defaults to "Not Started".

name: hierarchy_update
